detached_structure.evidence: A smaller roofed section with a darker gable sits just north of the main house roof, and there is a small gray shed-like structure at the lower center-right, though it may belong to a neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray gabled roof with some shading from nearby trees; mature trees surround the lot to the west and east, and white patio umbrellas or covers are visible in the backyard.
